etymology.historical_story: Jahnvi may be connected with Jāhnavī, a Sanskrit name associated with the Ganges. In a traditional Hindu narrative, the river receives that name through its connection with the sage Jahnu. This is cultural background for a possible related name, not proof of the origin or intended identity of this particular lowercase database item. [Sanskrit dictionary entries for Jāhnavī](https://www.wisdomlib.org/definition/jahnavi)
